service.description: TeamPlanner's data (mantle.work.ResourceServices.get#TeamPlan) with each allocation's canChange (an approver, or its requester while it is requested on a project the user manages), the person's link to PersonDetail, canRequest (the user may make an allocation on some project: an approver, or a manager of a project) and the projects the user may request on (requestProjectOptions).
The project roles an allocation fills (RoleGroupMember RgpProject less the client, vendor and team roles), as drop-down options, and the skills (Enumeration SkillType).

actions.script: const other = ['Customer', 'CustomerBillTo', 'ClientManager', 'ClientBilling', 'Vendor', 'VendorBillFrom', 'OrgTeam', 'Watcher', 'DefaultAssignee'] roleOptions = [] for (const row of ec.entity.find('mantle.party.RoleGroupMember').condition('roleGroupEnumId', 'RgpProject').useCache(true).disableAuthz().list()) { if (other.includes(row.roleTypeId)) continue roleOptions.push({value: row.roleTypeId, label: ec.entity.find('mantle.party.RoleType').condition('roleTypeId', row.roleTypeId).useCache(true) .disableAuthz().one()?.description || row.roleTypeId}) } roleOptions.sort((a, b) => a.label.localeCompare(b.label)) skillOptions = Array.from(ec.entity.find('moqui.basic.Enumeration').condition('enumTypeId', 'SkillType').orderBy('sequenceNum').orderBy('description') .useCache(true).disableAuthz().list()).map((row) => ({value: row.enumId, label: row.description || row.enumId}))

service.description: EditAllocation's values (Allocations' and PersonDetail's dialog; design-projects.md §9 AllocationForm): an allocation the user may change (workEffortAllocationId), or a new one (prefilled with workEffortId and partyId); the projects the user may request on (projectOptions: an approver every open project they see, else those they manage), the roles and skills, and isApprover. found false when the allocation is not available or not the user's to change.

AllocationForm (design-projects.md §9): a new allocation (no workEffortAllocationId; mantle.work.ResourceServices create#Allocation: allocated at once by an approver unless request is Y, else requested) or a change to one (update#Allocation), the amount as hours a week (unit h) or a percent of capacity (unit pct).
A drag on the team planner: shiftDays moves the allocation's days, or fromDate or thruDate stretches one end (mantle.work.ResourceServices.update#Allocation).
An allocation's action from the planner, Allocations or ProjectTeam: approve, reject (with a reason), cancel, or staff (partyId; an approver allocates it too).
Allocations' bulk decisions on the selected rows (selectedIds, a comma list): approve or reject (with a reason), each on its own; a failure is named and the rest go on.

Allocations' rows (design-projects.md §9 Allocations) over mantle.work.ResourceServices.find#Allocations: the list (requested, the default for one who approves; unstaffed; mine, the default for others; allocated; all), the find (project, person, from, thru), each row with its texts, status color and links; counts of each list.
Texts, colors and links of allocation rows (find#Allocations): whoText, periodText, statusColor, projectUrl, personUrl, rowKey.

actions.script: const L = (text) => ec.l10n.localize(text) const colors = {WealRequested: 'grey', WealAllocated: 'primary', WealRejected: 'negative', WealCancelled: 'negative'} rowList = Array.from(rowList || []).map((row) => Object.assign({}, row, {rowKey: row.workEffortAllocationId, whoText: row.personName || ([row.roleText, row.skillText ? '(' + row.skillText + ')' : ''].filter((part) => part).join(' ') || L('A person')), roleSkillText: [row.roleText, row.skillText].filter((part) => part).join(' · '), periodText: row.fromText + ' – ' + row.thruText, amountText: row.allocationPercent != null ? row.hoursText + ' ' + L('of capacity') : row.hoursText + ' ' + L('a week'), statusColor: colors[row.statusId] || 'grey', projectUrl: '/qapps/Projects/Projects/ProjectDetail?workEffortId=' + encodeURIComponent(row.rootWorkEffortId), personUrl: row.partyId ? '/qapps/Projects/Resources/PersonDetail?partyId=' + encodeURIComponent(row.partyId) : '', plannerUrl: '/qapps/Projects/Resources/TeamPlanner?rootWorkEffortId=' + encodeURIComponent(row.rootWorkEffortId) + '&fromDate=' + encodeURIComponent(row.fromDay), canStaff: !!row.canChange && row.isPlaceholder, isOpen: row.statusId === 'WealRequested' || row.statusId === 'WealAllocated'}))

service.description: StaffAllocation (design-projects.md §9): the allocation and its candidates (mantle.work.ResourceServices find#StaffingCandidates, the rates for those who manage money), each with its texts: the skill, the free hours, the short weeks, the current projects and the cost rate.

The people an allocation may name (AllocationForm's person, as drop-down options): those who keep time and those with a user, matching term; with fromDate, thruDate and hours (or pct) each label says the hours free a week at the least in the period (find#StaffingCandidates).
ProjectTeam's Allocations box (design-projects.md §4): the project's allocations still requested or allocated whose last day is not past, decorated, and canRequest (a manager of it or an approver).
Projects Home's allocation approvals: the requested allocations the user decides (five, oldest request first), as Home's Approvals rows (kindText, personName, whatText, hoursText, sinceText, url).

actions.script: approvalList = [] if (!ec.user.isInGroup('ADMIN') && !ec.user.hasPermission('ALLOCATION_APPROVE')) return const rows = Array.from(ec.service.sync().name('mantle.work.ResourceServices.find#Allocations').parameters({list: 'requested', withCounts: false}).call()?.rowList || []) rows.sort((a, b) => String(a.requestedDate || '').localeCompare(String(b.requestedDate || ''))) const L = (text) => ec.l10n.localize(text) approvalList = rows.slice(0, 5).map((row) => ({kind: 'allocation', personName: row.personName || [row.roleText, row.skillText ? '(' + row.skillText + ')' : ''] .filter((part) => part).join(' '), whatText: L('Allocation') + ' · ' + row.projectName + ' · ' + row.fromText + ' – ' + row.thruText, hoursText: row.allocationPercent != null ? row.hoursText : row.hoursText + ' / ' + L('week'), sinceText: row.requestedDate ? ec.l10n.format(row.requestedDate, 'MMM d') : '', url: '/qapps/Projects/Resources/Allocations?list=requested'}))

service.description: Whether the user sees a person in Projects: themselves, ADMIN, or a person on (or allocated to) a project the user sees. person: {partyId, name, userId}.

PersonDetail's Overview (design-projects.md §9 PersonDetail): the directory card (email, phone, the organizations they work for), the position (EmplPositionParty), the line managers (PrtManager), the skills (PartySkill), the working hours (the capacity's source and its first week's hours), and the load of weeks weeks from this one (get#TeamPlan of the person).
